work: The Meaning Of The Marriage Ceremony
heading: Liji 41 · Hun Yi 昏義 · The Meaning Of The Marriage Ceremony · Hun Yi 11 … Hun Yi 12

items.text: Be deferential and obedient to your husband.
items.quote: the deferential obedience of the wife

items.text: Guide and manage the external affairs of the household.
items.quote: the son of Heaven guided in all that affected the external administration (of affairs)

items.text: Regulate the internal affairs of the household and maintain harmony.
items.quote: the queen, in all that concerned the internal regulation (of the family)

items.text: Be necessary to each other and fulfill your functions through interdependence.
items.quote: They are necessary to each other, and by their interdependence they fulfil their functions.

work: The Meaning Of The Marriage Ceremony
heading: Liji 41 · Hun Yi 昏義 · The Meaning Of The Marriage Ceremony · Hun Yi 1 … Hun Yi 10

items.text: Give your son the special cup and order him to go and meet his bride, for the male takes the first step in all marriage arrangements.
items.quote: The father gave himself the special cup to his son, and ordered him to go and meet the bride

items.text: Greet your bride's father with a bow and present a wild goose, showing respect when you receive your bride.
items.quote: the bridegroom bowed twice and put down the wild goose

items.text: Treat your wife as your own body, of equal rank, and be pledged to mutual affection with her.
items.quote: thus showing that they now formed one body, were of equal rank, and pledged to mutual affection

items.text: Treat your husband as your own body, of equal rank, and be pledged to mutual affection with him.
items.quote: thus showing that they now formed one body, were of equal rank, and pledged to mutual affection

items.text: Rise early, wash, and present yourself to your husband's parents bearing a basket of dates, chestnuts, and dried meat, declaring yourself their son's wife.
items.quote: bearing a basket with dates, chestnuts, and slices of dried spiced meat

items.text: Offer sacrificed dried meat and liquor to your husband's ancestors, declaring yourself their son's wife.
items.quote: she offered in sacrifice some of the dried meat and also of the liquor
items.conflict: Offering sacrifice to ancestors conflicts with worship due to God alone (Exodus 20:3-5).

items.text: Set before your parents-in-law a dressed pig to show your obedient duty to them.
items.quote: she set before them a single dressed pig

items.text: When your parents-in-law entertain you, pledge them in a cup and receive the position of future mother of the family.
items.quote: showing that she would take the mother's place in the family

items.text: Be a fitting partner to your husband, harmonious with him.
items.quote: she was the fitting partner of her husband

items.text: Carry on all the work in silk and linen, making cloth and silken fabrics, and maintain a watchful care over the various stores and depositories of the household.
items.quote: could carry on all the work in silk and linen, making cloth and silken fabrics, and maintaining a watchful care over the various stores and depositories

items.text: See that your daughter is taught the virtue, speech, carriage, and work of a wife for three months before her marriage.
items.quote: she was taught there the virtue, the speech, the carriage, and the work of a wife

items.text: Offer a sacrifice with fish and soups made of duckweed and pondweed to your ancestor after completing your instruction.
items.quote: she offered a sacrifice (to the ancestor), using fish for the victim, and soups made of duckweed and pondweed
items.conflict: Offering sacrifice to ancestors conflicts with worship due to God alone (Exodus 20:3-5).
